snippet.title: No One Leaves the Field - Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
“She who sows in sorrow shall reap in silence.”
A folk horror tale of grief, witchcraft, and a curse that no one escapes.

You wake beside your car, locked out and stranded in the middle of nowhere.
A farmhouse flickers in the distance—but something moves between the stalks.

No One Leaves the Field is a first-person folk horror game set in a cursed wheat field that reshapes itself every time you enter.
Search for your keys, uncover the truth behind the Harvest Mother, and try to escape before the scarecrow finds you.
